summary: Add an optional required AES256 Oracle native network encryption profile across application pools, Oracle-capable images, deployment configuration, and qualification.
userImpact: Oracle application-database deployments can opt in to mandatory AES256 native network encryption independently of user SSO.

instructions: For existing Oracle databases, run the Oracle schema-owner migration before verify-only startup. Enabling native-aes256-required also requires the Oracle image and reviewed Oracle Net configuration.

configuration: ORACLE_NETWORK_ENCRYPTION defaults to default; native-aes256-required enables mandatory AES256 NNE and requires ORACLE_NET_CONFIG_DIR.

changes: Add optional Oracle deployment configuration without changing default connection behavior.

notes: Oracle assignment_key columns widen in place to VARCHAR2(4000 BYTE); values and indexes are preserved. Existing Oracle installations must apply this migration before verify-only application startup. Other database inventories and the PostgreSQL schema epoch remain unchanged.
Application rollback retains the widened Oracle columns; automatic shrinking is refused.

security: The required profile fails closed on invalid client configuration, unsupported transport overrides, missing Oracle Client libraries, and incompatible encryption negotiation.

Oracle Net configuration is checked and read through the same open file with a bounded read. Optional image publication verifies protected-main authority and the API-resolved stable released source before checkout.
Oracle image acceptance scans every committed application severity before browser qualification; publication retains the qualified bytes with signatures, CycloneDX SBOMs, and provenance.
knownLimitations: Client Oracle release-update and real identity-provider acceptance remain separate qualification gates.
rollback: Retain a previously qualified encrypted composition or stop service when deployment policy requires NNE; do not recover by disabling encryption.
validation: 60 focused Oracle contracts and 69 affected routing/native-SBOM/publication-authority/browser-preflight contracts passed; 183 CI contracts, 55 portability units, Helm positive/negative profiles and OpenShift rendering passed.

The initial compiled arm64 Oracle candidate and frontend passed pinned all-severity security scans. All 15 Oracle Free negotiation/upgrade scenarios and 9 Oracle-backed OIDC, Entra-compatible OIDC, signed SAML and LDAP browser journeys passed, with AES256 observed before and after SSO and zero unencrypted application sessions. Exact final-source dual-architecture acceptance remains a protected CI requirement after shipping fixes to bounded file reads, Linux scanner report ownership and ARM64 browser executable discovery.

PostgreSQL clean installation, populated upgrades, retry, service behavior and rollback passed on the local checkpoint; 5 database-only migration configuration checks passed. Oracle 21c XE fixture initialization stalled under local ARM emulation; native amd64 regression and dual-architecture acceptance remain CI requirements.
